options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: bandwidth
options.description: The total bandwidth amount allowed by this traffic shaper.

options.name: bandwidthtype
options.description: The scale type of the `bandwidth` field's value.

options.name: borrow
options.description: Allow this queue to borrow from other queues when available.

options.name: codel
options.description: Use the 'Codel Active Queue' scheduler option for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: default
options.description: Mark this traffic shaper queue as the default queue.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: ecn
options.description: Use the 'Explicit Congestion Notification' scheduler option for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enables or disables the traffic shaper queue.

options.name: hogs
options.description: The bandwidth limit per host.

options.name: linkshare
options.description: Allow sharing bandwidth from this queue for other queues as long as the real time values have been satisfied.

options.name: linkshare_d
options.description: The duration (in milliseconds) that the initial bandwidth limit (`linkshare_m1`) is in effect.

options.name: linkshare_m1
options.description: The initial bandwidth limit for this traffic shaper queue when link sharing.

options.name: linkshare_m2
options.description: The maximum bandwidth this traffic shaper queue is allowed to use. Note: This behaves exactly the same as the `bandwidth` field. If this field is set, it will override whatever value is current assigned to the `bandwidth` field.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: name
options.description: The name to assign this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: parent_lookup_query
options.description: A dictionary of query parameters used to look up the parent Traffic Shaper. This should contain field name/value pairs that uniquely identify the parent object this resource is nested under.

options.name: priority
options.description: The priority level for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: qlimit
options.description: The number of packets that can be held in a queue waiting to be transmitted by the shaper.

options.name: realtime
options.description: Allow setting the guaranteed bandwidth minimum allotted to the queue.

options.name: realtime_d
options.description: The duration (in milliseconds) that the guaranteed bandwidth limit (`realtime_m1`) is in effect.

options.name: realtime_m1
options.description: The guaranteed minimum bandwidth limit for this traffic shaper queue during real time.

options.name: realtime_m2
options.description: The maximum bandwidth this traffic shaper queue is allowed to use. Note: This value should not exceed 30% of parent queue's maximum bandwidth.

options.name: red
options.description: Use the 'Random Early Detection' scheduler option for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: rio
options.description: Use the 'Random Early Detection In and Out' scheduler option for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: upperlimit
options.description: Allow setting the maximum bandwidth allowed for the queue. Will force hard bandwidth limiting.

options.name: upperlimit_d
options.description: The duration (in milliseconds) that the burst-able bandwidth limit (`upperlimit_m1` is in effect.

options.name: upperlimit_m1
options.description: The burst-able bandwidth limit for this traffic shaper queue.

options.name: upperlimit_m2
options.description: The normal bandwidth limit for this traffic shaper queue. If `upperlimit_m1` is not defined, this limit will always be in effect. If `upperlimit_m1` is defined, this limit will take effect after the `upperlimit_d` duration has expired.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
